title: Agudah Yarchei Kallah Yerushalayim
body: Agudath Israel of America announces the 5786 Yarchei Kallah in Yerushalayim, a five-day Torah immersion program for lomdei Torah from around the world.

title: Toldos Avrohom Yitzchok Rebbe
body: Hundreds of chassidim gathered for the Zos Chanukah tish in Yerushalayim's Meah Shearim neighborhood when the Toldos Avrohom Yitzchok Rebbe made a surprise entrance wearing a traditional kolpik hat, moving the crowd with his appearance.
